summary: Planet Green Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the disposition of its 100% equity interest in Bless Chemical Co., Ltd. (HK), the indirect owner of Jingshan Sanhe Luckysky New Energy Technologies Co., Ltd., to Hongzhang Liang for nominal consideration. The board approved the divestiture to streamline operations and reduce liabilities, as Jingshan had ceased active operations and generated no revenue. Post-closing, Bless HK and Jingshan will no longer be consolidated. Pro forma financials were filed as an exhibit. Watch for the impact of removing Jingshan's liabilities from the balance sheet and the company's renewed focus on its core consumer and digital advertising segments.
